title: 3d models in unity advice
author: kkwikmick
selftext:
So ive been making my game in unity and the biggest struggle ive seem to come across is animations and rigging.

Ive got claude and codex linked to unity and blender via mcp and i can get it working but it just looks a bit janky

i bought an asset pack from the humble bundle and used those with basic humanoid shapes for claude to rig and apply the animations from mixamo.

for some reason the animations just dont look like the previews on my character models. Also i need to get some new animations for my models.

any advice on getting models rigged and applying animations?

ive been looking into kimodo to try and get some more custom animations. Ive also looked at some free mocap software and trying to mocap some animations from videos but havnt tried it yet.

any suggestions on this?  
thanks

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: I'll have to check it out tomorrow
